svg.title: One request through the Lock Family: masked read, held write, approval, audit
svg.desc: An agent on the left, lox run on the right, your shell below. Step 1: the agent reads the pending order through locksql; the customer name and email come back as <redacted>, and lox run logs the read as approved by an auto rule. Step 2: the agent asks for an UPDATE of the order status; it gets a pending ticket, and lox run shows a question card with the statement, its values masked. Step 3: you press y in lox run, outside the agent; the agent runs the write with the decided ticket and one row changes. Step 4: lox audit lists both exchanges, the read decided by an auto rule and the write by a human.
